meta.measurementScope: Main-agent input and output across recorded attempts, including retries and invalid outputs; memory processing excluded equally for every configuration.
meta.memoryScope: Returned context: benchmark-token count summed once per task. Memory in prompts: repeated benchmark-token counts at successful agent steps. Neither is an API billing-token count.
limitations: Twenty tasks in four related families; one observation per configuration, not three repeated full-matrix runs.
These are measurements of benchmark adapters, not all competitors' hosted plans and not measured production-cloud latency.
The history baseline is limited to 1024 benchmark tokens in its memory insertion, not unlimited history or a native agent compactor.
Five configurations retain earlier results from the same matrix; each source run is identified.
Task completion and observed safety violations are separate from incomplete backend cost telemetry in some original reports.
Lower token usage is not a guarantee of equivalent dollar savings or subscription payback.
meta.taskSeriesScope: Per-task agent input and output across recorded attempts, including retries and invalid outputs; prompts, responses, provider connection details and request identifiers omitted.
